title: Make Other People Come to You - Use Bait If Necessary
hook: The rare book on the table makes Anders see bait before anyone names it.
counterintuition: Direct force looks honest, but it can spend leverage too early. The sharper move is to handle bait while the other side is still reading the surface.
tryThisNow: Find one decision you are about to make public. Move one detail so bait works for you before anyone argues over the larger issue.
keyTakeaway: Make others cross the distance toward your ground before you spend your own position.

breakdown.fastRead:
Julien lifts the map in the gallery. The make choice looks small, yet it can shift proof.

Favor feels fast for Julien. It also gives the room a clean target.

Keep other close and plain. One clear act should change what others can do next.

If the map move feels false or cruel, narrow it. Power lasts when Julien leaves fewer loose ends.
breakdown.deepRead: Lars faces the same pattern in tennis coach using a tournament slot as bait for a reluctant player. The useful distinction is bait, initiative, movement. Apply the move through the setup, not through a generic speech.
breakdown.fullRead: Mikkel sees the limit clearly in vendor contract negotiation held at the buyer's warehouse floor. The move helps only when it stays narrower than waiting passively for people to notice you. If it becomes a pose, it loses the practical force that made it useful.
